boss_fire_drake.reference_hint: pick the matching creature archetype from this encyclopedia for anatomy and costume ideas only
boss_fire_drake.subject: A fire drake boss, wingless red dragon with black horns, molten orange belly, smoke from nostrils, four clawed legs, spiked tail. Windup inhales with glowing throat; contact breathes a short burst of flame and bites. Boss-sized silhouette with an imposing presence. Attack windup rears back and gathers strength; attack contact strikes forward hard with a clearly different pose; death lies collapsed flat. Distinct from the style reference subject.
